lessons.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
lessons.title_zh: 輝達駁回「讓黃仁勳回來」活動，川普則支持恢復前執行長職位之努力

paragraphs.en: Nvidia has rejected calls to bring back its co-founder and former chief executive, Jensen Huang. Huang recently stepped down after reports surfaced regarding two personal affairs, one of which involved a suspected Chinese spy. Despite his sudden exit, a public petition demanding his return has gathered more than 175,000 signatures from employees, shareholders, and supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 輝達（Nvidia）已駁回要求讓其共同創辦人兼前執行長黃仁勳回任的呼聲。黃仁勳在有關兩段個人婚外情的報導曝光後於近期辭職，其中一段涉及一名疑似中國間諜的女性。儘管他突然離職，一份要求他回歸的公開請願書已募集了來自員工、股東和支持者超過十七萬五千份簽名。

paragraphs.en: Several high-profile figures have supported Huang's comeback. United States President Donald Trump stated that he "would certainly not mind" seeing Huang return to his position. Tech leaders, such as Elon Musk of SpaceX, also expressed concern, warning that crucial business relationships could disappear without Huang. However, Nvidia's board of directors made it clear that they do not plan to rehire him, leaving Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress in charge as interim leader.
paragraphs.zh: 幾位知名人士對黃仁勳的回歸表示支持。美國總統唐納．川普表示，他「當然不介意」看到黃仁勳重返職位。包含 SpaceX 的伊隆．馬斯克在內的科技業領袖也表達了擔憂，警告如果沒有黃仁勳，關鍵的商業關係可能會消失。然而，輝達董事會明確表示他們並不打算重新聘用他，讓財務長柯蕾特．克雷斯以臨時領導人身分接管掌舵。

paragraphs.en: The scandal has created serious national security concerns because the woman involved was linked to a Singaporean data company. Although China has denied that she is a spy, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is investigating the situation, and Huang has agreed to testify before the United States Congress. Officials worry that advanced artificial intelligence chips might have been secretly redirected to China despite existing trade bans.
paragraphs.zh: 這起醜聞引發了嚴重的國家安全疑慮，因為涉案女子與一家新加坡資料公司有關聯。儘管中國否認她是間諜，美國聯邦調查局（FBI）正在調查該情況，且黃仁勳已同意前往美國國會作證。官員們擔憂，儘管存在現行的貿易禁令，先進人工智慧晶片仍可能已被暗中轉運至中國。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, the White House announced stricter export rules for overseas data centers in countries such as Singapore and Malaysia. Under these new regulations, foreign firms must apply for special licenses to obtain advanced chips. The government wants to prevent sensitive American technology from reaching competitors. Even though Nvidia's stock market value dropped significantly after the crisis began, the company remains extremely powerful in the global race for artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，白宮針對新加坡和馬來西亞等國家的海外資料中心宣布了更嚴格的出口規定。在這些新規範下，外國企業必須申請特殊許可才能取得先進晶片。政府希望防止敏感的美國技術落入競爭對手手中。即使在危機爆發後輝達的股市市值大幅縮水，該公司在全球人工智慧競賽中仍然極具影響力。

grammar.point: 介系詞加關係代名詞 (Preposition + Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: which 為關係代名詞，在此指稱先行詞「two personal affairs」，與介系詞 of 連用形成「one of which」引導形容詞子句。
grammar.example: Huang recently stepped down after reports surfaced regarding two personal affairs, one of which involved a suspected Chinese spy.
grammar.focus: one of which involved

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞 warning 表伴隨狀態，省略了連接詞與重複的主詞 Tech leaders。
grammar.example: Tech leaders, such as Elon Musk of SpaceX, also expressed concern, warning that crucial business relationships could disappear without Huang.
grammar.focus: , warning that

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: that 引導名詞子句，在主要動詞 stated 後面擔任受詞。
grammar.example: United States President Donald Trump stated that he "would certainly not mind" seeing Huang return to his position.
grammar.focus: that he "would certainly not mind" seeing Huang return to his position

lessons.title: New Zealand tricks and annual leave - the lengths fans are going to for GTA 6
lessons.title_zh: 紐西蘭妙招與特休假——粉絲們為了《俠盜獵車手6》所付出的種種極致努力

paragraphs.en: After waiting thirteen years, fans of Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) are making huge efforts to get ready for the blockbuster video game. Market intelligence company Sensor Tower estimates that the game has already earned 1.18 billion dollars from 12 million pre-orders, though developer Rockstar has not officially confirmed these figures. Meanwhile, British internet providers have expanded network capacity to manage the heavy traffic expected for the 212-gigabyte download.
paragraphs.zh: 在等待了十三年之後，《俠盜獵車手6》（GTA 6）的粉絲們正付出巨大努力，為這款熱門暢銷電玩做好準備。市場情報公司 Sensor Tower 估計，這款遊戲已從 1,200 萬份預購中賺取了 11.8 億美元，儘管開發商 Rockstar 尚未正式證實這些數據。與此同時，英國的網際網路供應商也擴充了網路容量，以應對這款 212 GB 下載所帶來的預期龐大流量。

paragraphs.en: Many players are booking time off work so they can dive into the game immediately. A human resources company named BrightHR examined absence data from over 1.2 million UK workers and found that GTA appeared in 4.6 percent of leave applications, accounting for roughly 83,000 requested days off. Some organizations are even offering incentives connected to the game. For instance, a US Army division gave active-duty soldiers a four-day pass to play upon release, provided they reenlisted for at least two years.
paragraphs.zh: 許多玩家紛紛向公司請假，以便能立即投入這款遊戲。一家名為 BrightHR 的人力資源公司檢視了英國超過 120 萬名員工的請假資料，發現有 4.6% 的請假申請中提及了 GTA，相當於約 83,000 天被預訂的休假。有些組織甚至提供與這款遊戲相關的誘因。例如，美國陸軍的一個師向現役士兵提供四天的假期以在遊戲發售時遊玩，條件是他們必須簽署至少兩年的留營續約。

paragraphs.en: In addition, some gamers hope to play earlier by altering their console location settings. Because the game launches at midnight local time across different regions, New Zealand receives access first. UK online searches for this technical loophole have increased dramatically. However, gaming analyst Louise Wooldridge warned that platform companies have strict rules regarding regional accounts. Xbox and PlayStation users who attempt this workaround could violate user terms and face restrictions on their accounts.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，一些玩家希望能透過更改主機的地區設定來提早遊玩。由於這款遊戲會在不同地區的當地時間午夜推出，紐西蘭最先開放遊玩。英國境內針對這種技術漏洞的線上搜尋量急劇增加。然而，遊戲分析師 Louise Wooldridge 警告，平台公司對地區帳號有嚴格的規定。嘗試這種變通辦法的 Xbox 和 PlayStation 使用者可能會違反使用者條款，並面臨其帳號受到限制的風險。

paragraphs.en: Finally, because GTA 6 will not be available on personal computers (PCs) at launch, some dedicated fans are paying hundreds of pounds for new gaming systems. Despite the high price of new hardware, players are buying consoles just to enjoy this single title. After more than a decade of anticipation, millions of gamers appear willing to invest significant time and money to experience the release without delay.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，由於《俠盜獵車手6》在首發上市時不會在個人電腦（PC）上推出，一些死忠粉絲正花費數百英鎊購買新的遊戲主機。儘管新硬體設備價格高昂，玩家們仍專門為了享受這款單一作品而購買主機。在經歷了十多年的期盼之後，數百萬名玩家似乎願意投入大量的時間與金錢，以便能毫不延誤地體驗這場遊戲發行。

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 引導完整的名詞子句，在及物動詞 estimates 後面作為受詞使用。
grammar.example: Market intelligence company Sensor Tower estimates that the game has already earned 1.18 billion dollars from 12 million pre-orders, though developer Rockstar has not officially confirmed these figures.
grammar.focus: that the game has already earned 1.18 billion dollars from 12 million pre-orders

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞 accounting for 作為分詞構句，用以修飾前方主要子句並補充說明造成的結果。
grammar.example: A human resources company named BrightHR examined absence data from over 1.2 million UK workers and found that GTA appeared in 4.6 percent of leave applications, accounting for roughly 83,000 requested days off.
grammar.focus: accounting for roughly 83,000 requested days off

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Adjective Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 who 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾先行詞 users，並在該子句中擔任主詞。
grammar.example: Xbox and PlayStation users who attempt this workaround could violate user terms and face restrictions on their accounts.
grammar.focus: who attempt this workaround

lessons.title: Brain cell mapping lays groundwork for better treatments for conditions like dementia
lessons.title_zh: 大腦細胞繪圖為失智症等疾病的更好療法奠定基礎

paragraphs.en: The human brain is very complex and contains over 80 billion neurons. Recently, an international team of scientists created a detailed cellular map of the basal ganglia. This small area is tucked beneath the cortex and takes up only about two percent of the brain's volume, but it plays a powerful role in controlling our movements, making decisions, and forming daily habits.
paragraphs.zh: 人類的大腦非常複雜，包含超過八百億個神經元。最近，一個國際科學家團隊繪製了基底核的詳細細胞圖譜。這個小區域隱藏在大腦皮質下方，僅占大腦體積的約百分之二，但它在控制我們的運動、做出決策以及養成日常習慣方面扮演著強大的角色。

paragraphs.en: Because the basal ganglia control these important actions, problems in this region are tied to several serious brain disorders. These include neurodegenerative conditions like Parkinson's disease and Huntington's disease, as well as mental health issues like depression and schizophrenia. Scientists chose this area first because it is shared across humans and other animals, making it an ideal place to compare species.
paragraphs.zh: 由於基底核控制著這些重要行為，該區域的問題與幾種嚴重的腦部疾病密切相關。這些疾病包括像帕金森氏症和亨丁頓舞蹈症等神經退化性疾病，以及像憂鬱症和思覺失調症等心理健康問題。科學家首先選擇這個區域，是因為人類和其他動物都擁有它，使其成為比較物種的理想起點。

paragraphs.en: To build the atlas, researchers examined more than 25 million cells from humans, macaques, and marmosets. They recorded where each cell was located and which genes it expressed. The result is a three-dimensional map that shows cell types and reveals which cells carry genes linked to illnesses like Alzheimer's or Parkinson's. This major three-year effort involved researchers at more than 50 institutions and was funded mainly by the National Institutes of Health (NIH).
paragraphs.zh: 為了建立這幅圖譜，研究人員檢視了來自人類、獼猴和狨猴的超過兩千五百萬個細胞。他們記錄了每個細胞所在的位置以及它表達了哪些基因。結果呈現出一幅三維地圖，顯示細胞類型並揭示哪些細胞攜帶與阿茲海默症或帕金森氏症等疾病相關的基因。這項耗時三年的重大工作涉及五十多個機構的研究人員，主要由美國國家衛生研究院（NIH）資助。

paragraphs.en: Experts believe this new discovery could lead to better medical treatments with fewer side effects. For example, some current Parkinson's drugs can cause dangerous behaviors like gambling. A clearer map can help scientists design more precise medicines. Scientists now plan to use this same method as a template to map the entire brain over the next few years.
paragraphs.zh: 專家認為這項新發現可能帶來副作用更少、更好的醫療處方。例如，一些現有的帕金森氏症藥物可能會引起像嗜賭等危險行為。更清晰的地圖可以幫助科學家設計更精確的藥物。科學家現在計劃在未來幾年內將這同一套方法作為範本，來繪製整個大腦的圖譜。

grammar.point: 關係子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 that 引導形容詞子句，修飾先行詞 a three-dimensional map，在子句中作主詞。
grammar.example: The result is a three-dimensional map that shows cell types and reveals which cells carry genes linked to illnesses like Alzheimer's or Parkinson's.
grammar.focus: that shows cell types and reveals which cells carry genes

grammar.point: 過去分詞作後位修飾 (Past Participle as Post-Modifier)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語 linked to... 置於名詞 genes 之後，用來作後位修飾，表被動或狀態。
grammar.example: The result is a three-dimensional map that shows cell types and reveals which cells carry genes linked to illnesses like Alzheimer's or Parkinson's.
grammar.focus: linked to illnesses like Alzheimer's or Parkinson's

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to map the entire brain... 是不定詞片語，用來說明採取此方法作為範本的目的。
grammar.example: Scientists now plan to use this same method as a template to map the entire brain over the next few years.
grammar.focus: to map the entire brain over the next few years

lessons.title: Band of baby sea turtles swims into ocean after historic California nesting
lessons.title_zh: 歷史性加州產卵後，一群小海龜游入大海

paragraphs.en: In an unprecedented event on the US west coast, a group of seventy-five baby olive ridley sea turtles was recently released into the Pacific Ocean. The young turtles had hatched from eggs discovered two months earlier on southern California beaches. This release marks the first time that native-born sea turtles of this species have emerged from nests recorded in this region.
paragraphs.zh: 在美國西岸一場史無前例的事件中，一群七十五隻欖蠵龜幼龜最近被野放到太平洋中。這些小海龜是由兩個月前在南加州海灘上發現的卵孵化而來的。這次野放標誌著該物種在當地出生的海龜，首次從該地區記錄到的巢穴中破殼而出。

paragraphs.en: The unusual event began on September 16, when an olive ridley sea turtle was spotted digging a nest and laying eggs on Seal Beach. Just three days later, another turtle was observed making a nest on Huntington Beach. Because Hurricane Polo began to threaten the area in late September, researchers relocated 204 eggs from both nests to an animal care facility at the Aquarium of the Pacific in Long Beach to ensure their safety.
paragraphs.zh: 這起不尋常的事件始於九月十六日，當時有人看見一隻欖蠵龜在海豹灘（Seal Beach）挖巢並產卵。就在三天後，另一隻海龜被目擊在杭廷頓灘（Huntington Beach）築巢。由於颶風波洛（Hurricane Polo）在九月下旬開始威脅該地區，研究人員將兩個巢穴中的兩百零四顆卵轉移到長灘太平洋水族館（Aquarium of the Pacific）的動物照護設施中，以確保牠們的安全。

paragraphs.en: Olive ridley sea turtles are typically a tropical species found in the Pacific, Indian, and Atlantic oceans. They normally nest much farther south, along the tip of Baja California. Experts believe that unusual weather patterns, such as this year's El Niño conditions and a recent tropical storm, likely influenced the turtles' journey north. Navigational mistakes and the natural flexibility of the species might also have played a role.
paragraphs.zh: 欖蠵龜通常是生活在太平洋、印度洋和大西洋的熱帶物種。牠們通常在更南邊的下加利福尼亞半島南端築巢。專家認為，異常的氣候型態，例如今年的聖嬰現象與最近的熱帶風暴，很可能影響了海龜向北移動的旅程。導航錯誤以及該物種天生的彈性也可能起到了一定作用。

paragraphs.en: After fifty-eight days of incubation, the eggs began to hatch. Aquarium staff released fifty-four hatchlings from the Seal Beach nest and twenty-one from the Huntington Beach nest into the sea. Jeffrey Flocken, the president and CEO of the aquarium, stated that "humans will need to adapt and make space" to help endangered wildlife survive.
paragraphs.zh: 經過五十八天的孵化期後，這些卵開始孵化。水族館工作人員將海豹灘巢穴的五十四隻幼龜以及杭廷頓灘巢穴的二十一隻幼龜放回大海。該水族館的總裁兼執行長傑弗瑞．弗洛肯（Jeffrey Flocken）表示，「人類需要調適並讓出空間」，以幫助瀕危野生動物生存下去。

paragraphs.en: Marine scientists are still advising beachgoers to watch for additional nests. In fact, a third nest was reported on November 1 in Ventura county, although high tides unfortunately washed those eggs away. Even so, experts hope these young turtles will eventually return to the same beaches to produce future generations.
paragraphs.zh: 海洋科學家仍建議海灘遊客留意更多的巢穴。事實上，十一月一日在范杜拉郡（Ventura county）記錄到了第三個巢穴，儘管那些卵不幸被大潮沖走了。即便如此，專家仍希望這些小海龜最終能返回同一片海灘繁衍後代。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語作後位修飾 (Past Participle Phrase as Postmodifier)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語「discovered...」作為後位修飾語，修飾前面的名詞 eggs，相當於省略了 which were 的關係子句。
grammar.example: The young turtles had hatched from eggs discovered two months earlier on southern California beaches.
grammar.focus: discovered two months earlier on southern California beaches

grammar.point: 關係副詞引導非限定子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause with Relative Adverb)
grammar.explain: 關係副詞 when 引導非限定關係子句，前面加上逗號，補充說明時間先行詞 September 16 當天發生的事情。
grammar.example: The unusual event began on September 16, when an olive ridley sea turtle was spotted digging a nest and laying eggs on Seal Beach.
grammar.focus: when an olive ridley sea turtle was spotted digging a nest and laying eggs on Seal Beach

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語「to ensure...」在此作副詞用，說明主詞採取遷移海龜卵行動的目的。
grammar.example: Because Hurricane Polo began to threaten the area in late September, researchers relocated 204 eggs from both nests to an animal care facility at the Aquarium of the Pacific in Long Beach to ensure their safety.
grammar.focus: to ensure their safety

lessons.title: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
lessons.title_zh: 輝達風波之際 美國加強遠端存取人工智慧技術之管制

paragraphs.en: The United States government has introduced a new policy to stop foreign rivals from remotely using American artificial intelligence chips and servers. In the past, companies in nations facing trade bans could still reach these powerful systems through computing centers located overseas. This latest measure by the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), an agency under the Commerce Department, seeks to close that loophole and protect national security.
paragraphs.zh: 美國政府推出了一項新政策，以防止外國競爭對手遠端使用美國的人工智慧晶片與伺服器。過去，面臨貿易禁令國家境內的公司仍可透過設於海外的運算中心，使用這些強大的系統。這項由商務部下屬的工業與安全局（BIS）所發布的最新措施，旨在防堵該漏洞並維護國家安全。

paragraphs.en: This major action comes amid serious turmoil at Nvidia, the world's most prominent maker of AI processors. Jensen Huang stepped down as chief executive officer last week after reports exposed his romantic relationship with a woman whom intelligence officials suspected of spying for China. NPR has not independently confirmed these claims. The woman, Alice Huang, previously worked as an executive at Megaspeed International, a Singapore-based computing company with facilities in Malaysia.
paragraphs.zh: 這項重大舉措正值全球最著名的人工智慧處理器製造商輝達（Nvidia）陷入嚴重風波之際。在有報導揭露執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）與一名遭情報官員懷疑為中國從事間諜活動的女子有感情關係後，他於上週辭去了執行長一職。全國公共廣播電台（NPR）尚未獨立證實這些說法。該名女子名為 Alice Huang，先前曾於總部位於新加坡、且在馬來西亞設有設施的運算公司 Megaspeed International 擔任高階主管。

paragraphs.en: Federal officials noted that rapid progress in cloud computing has allowed foreign businesses to connect to advanced American machines from afar. Jensen Huang had previously tried to persuade President Donald Trump to relax trade barriers regarding chip sales to China. Meanwhile, Megaspeed maintained that its commercial operations are lawful, adding that the firm has hired independent lawyers to conduct a complete internal inquiry.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦官員指出，雲端運算的快速進步使外國企業得以從遠端連線到先進的美國機器。黃仁勳此前曾試圖說服唐納·川普（Donald Trump）總統放寬針對向中國銷售晶片的貿易限制。與此同時，Megaspeed 堅稱其商業運作完全合法，並補充表示該公司已聘請獨立律師進行全面的內部調查。

paragraphs.en: The situation has renewed intense political debate in Washington. Earlier, the Trump administration had rejected strict regulations, even dismissing an export control plan developed under the previous Biden administration. However, lawmakers are now preparing to examine the issue thoroughly. Both Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick are scheduled to appear before Congress, where politicians want to investigate what occurred under oath.
paragraphs.zh: 這種情況重新引發了華盛頓激烈的政治爭論。早些時候，川普政府曾拒絕嚴格的法規，甚至廢棄了在前任拜登（Biden）政府領導下所制定的出口管制計畫。然而，國會議員如今正準備徹查這個問題。黃仁勳與商務部長霍華德·盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）皆預計將出席國會作證，政界人士希望在宣誓的情況下調查究竟發生了什麼事。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Adjective Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: whom 作為關係代名詞，用以指涉前面的先行詞 a woman，並在關係子句中作動詞 suspected 的受詞。
grammar.example: Jensen Huang stepped down as chief executive officer last week after reports exposed his romantic relationship with a woman whom intelligence officials suspected of spying for China.
grammar.focus: whom intelligence officials suspected of spying for China

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 由 has 加上過去分詞 allowed 形成現在完成式，表示過去已發生的技術進步對當前所造成的影響與持續狀態。
grammar.example: Federal officials noted that rapid progress in cloud computing has allowed foreign businesses to connect to advanced American machines from afar.
grammar.focus: has allowed

grammar.point: 現在分詞構句 (Present Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞 adding 引導分詞構句，以逗號與前方的主要子句分開，用來補充說明主詞所伴隨發生的動作或陳述。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, Megaspeed maintained that its commercial operations are lawful, adding that the firm has hired independent lawyers to conduct a complete internal inquiry.
grammar.focus: , adding that the firm has hired independent lawyers to conduct a complete internal inquiry

lessons.title: Thousands of Chase Bank customers report trouble with online banking services
lessons.title_zh: 數千名大通銀行客戶回報線上銀行服務出現問題

paragraphs.en: On Monday, thousands of Chase Bank customers reported problems accessing their online banking services. The bank explained that a software bug caused the disruption, which led to delays in helping clients. Physical branches also experienced transaction difficulties due to internal system issues. However, Chase assured customers that they could still reach their funds, clarifying that the breakdown stemmed from an update to their physical computers rather than a cyberattack.
paragraphs.zh: 週一，數千名大通銀行（Chase Bank）的客戶回報在登入其線上銀行服務時遇到困難。該銀行解釋，軟體錯誤導致了這次中斷，進而使得為客戶提供服務的時間比平常更久。實體分行也因為內部系統問題而出現交易困難。然而，大通銀行向客戶保證他們仍然可以使用自己的資金，並澄清這次故障源自於自家實體電腦系統的更新，而非網路攻擊。

paragraphs.en: According to the tracking website Downdetector, over 4,700 people reported problems with Chase on Monday afternoon. Other major financial institutions, including Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and U.S. Bank, also saw smaller issues. These disruptions were mainly connected to customers transferring money to Chase through Zelle, a digital payment service. U.S. Bank and Zelle both noted that their own systems were functioning, but transactions involving Chase suffered delays.
paragraphs.zh: 根據追蹤網站 Downdetector 的資料，週一下午有超過 4,700 人回報大通銀行出現問題。包括美國銀行（Bank of America）、富國銀行（Wells Fargo）及美國合眾銀行（U.S. Bank）在內的其他大型金融機構，也出現了規模較小的問題。這些混亂主要與客戶透過數位支付服務 Zelle 轉帳至大通銀行帳戶有關。美國合眾銀行和 Zelle 皆指出自身系統運作正常，但涉及大通銀行的交易出現了延誤。

paragraphs.en: The trouble at Chase was the third major technological failure within three consecutive weekdays. On Thursday, a Microsoft outage blocked email access for millions of users across 74 countries. On Friday, a Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) system breakdown triggered nationwide flight groundings. Furthermore, United Airlines suffered a computer failure on Monday that delayed flights. Although each incident had different causes, they all revealed how vulnerable modern infrastructure can be.
paragraphs.zh: 大通銀行的這起問題，是連續三個平日內發生的第三起重大技術故障。週四，微軟（Microsoft）的服務中斷切斷了 74 個國家及地區數百萬名使用者的電子郵件存取權限。週五，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的系統故障導致全美航班暫停起飛。此外，聯合航空（United Airlines）在週一下午也遭遇電腦系統故障，造成航班延誤。儘管每起事件的原因各不相同，但它們都揭示了現代基礎設施有多麼脆弱。

paragraphs.en: Experts pointed out that today's society relies heavily on connected networks. Mike Chapple, a professor at the University of Notre Dame, noted that small local errors can quickly spread across an entire nation. While complex systems can be resilient, unexpected failures may still cascade into other industries. As Madhu Shashanka, founder of Concentric AI, explained, the main challenge is "how fast you can contain it."
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出，當今社會高度依賴相互連結的網路。聖母大學（University of Notre Dame）教授麥克．查普爾（Mike Chapple）指出，單一局部的微小錯誤便能迅速在全美擴散。雖然複雜的系統能具有復原力，但意料之外的故障仍可能連鎖波及其他產業。正如 Concentric AI 創辦人馬杜．沙尚卡（Madhu Shashanka）所言，主要的挑戰在於「你能多快控制住它」。

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining relative clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的關係代名詞「which」用來補充說明前面的軟體錯誤問題所帶來的後果。
grammar.example: The bank explained that a software bug caused the disruption, which led to delays in helping clients.
grammar.focus: which led to delays in helping clients

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverbial clause of concession)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞「Although」引導副詞子句，表示「雖然、儘管」，說明各事件原因雖不同，但皆暴露出相同問題。
grammar.example: Although each incident had different causes, they all revealed how vulnerable modern infrastructure can be.
grammar.focus: Although each incident had different causes

grammar.point: 間接問句 (Indirect question)
grammar.explain: 由疑問詞「how」加上形容詞「vulnerable」引導名詞子句，作主要子句及物動詞「revealed」的受詞。
grammar.example: Although each incident had different causes, they all revealed how vulnerable modern infrastructure can be.
grammar.focus: how vulnerable modern infrastructure can be

lessons.title: Far from home. Voyager 1 is now farther than anything man has sent into space
lessons.title_zh: 遠離家園。航海家一號如今比人類送入太空的任何物體都還要遙遠

paragraphs.en: NASA's Voyager 1 has traveled farther than any other object human beings have sent into the universe. The spacecraft launched on September 5, 1977, and it is now set to reach an extraordinary milestone: a distance of one light-day from Earth. A light-day represents the distance that light can travel over twenty-four hours, which equals more than sixteen billion miles. To celebrate this moment, NASA invited the public to flash the letters V-G-R in Morse code toward the night sky using flashlights or mobile phones.
paragraphs.zh: 美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）的航海家一號航行的距離，比人類送入宇宙的任何其他物體都還要遙遠。這艘太空船於1977年9月5日發射升空，如今即將達成一個非凡的里程碑：距離地球整整一個「光日」。一個光日代表光在二十四小時內所行進的距離，相當於超過一百六十億英里。為了慶祝這個時刻，NASA邀請大眾使用手電筒或手機，朝著夜空以摩斯密碼閃爍出「V-G-R」這幾個字母。

paragraphs.en: During its decades of exploration, Voyager 1 has achieved numerous scientific successes. The probe flew past Jupiter in 1979, where it discovered a faint ring system around the giant planet. One year later, it captured detailed photographs of Saturn and its surrounding moons. On February 17, 1998, the spacecraft overtook another American probe, Pioneer 10. This made Voyager 1 the most distant human-made object in existence.
paragraphs.zh: 在數十年的探索過程中，航海家一號取得了許多科學上的成功。該探測器於1979年飛越木星，並在那顆巨大的行星周圍發現了一個微弱的環系統。一年後，它拍攝了土星及其周圍衛星的詳細照片。在1998年2月17日，這艘太空船超越了另一艘美國探測器先鋒10號。這使航海家一號成為現存最遙遠的人造物體。

paragraphs.en: In 2012, Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space. It and its twin probe, Voyager 2, remain the only two spacecraft that have operated outside the protective shield of our solar system, known as the heliosphere. To preserve its limited electrical power, NASA recently turned off one experiment that studied low-energy charged particles. Scientists explained that this difficult step could help the spacecraft stay operational for a longer period. Today, two scientific instruments continue to function, recording magnetic fields and plasma waves.
paragraphs.zh: 2012年，航海家一號進入了星際空間。它與其孿生探測器航海家二號，仍是僅有兩艘在被稱為日光層的太陽系保護罩之外運作的太空船。為了保存其有限的電力，NASA最近關閉了一項研究低能帶電粒子的實驗。科學家解釋說，這個艱難的舉措可能有助於太空船保持運作更長的時間。如今，仍有兩台科學儀器持續運作，記錄著磁場與電漿波。

paragraphs.en: Besides scientific equipment, the spacecraft also carries the famous Golden Record, which acts as a special time capsule for extraterrestrial life. This gold-plated disc contains one hundred and fifteen images, natural sounds like wind and ocean waves, and greetings recorded in thirty-five languages. According to NASA estimates, Voyager 1 will officially achieve light-day status after journeying for forty-nine years, two months, and eleven days.
paragraphs.zh: 除了科學儀器外，這艘太空船還攜帶著著名的金唱片，作為向外星生命傳遞訊息的特殊「時空膠囊」。這張鍍金唱片收錄了一百一十五張影像、像是風聲與海浪聲等自然聲音，以及用三十五種語言錄製的問候語。根據NASA的估計，航海家一號在歷經四十九年兩個月又十一天的航行後，將正式達到「光日」的狀態。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首使用「To preserve...」的不定詞片語，用來清楚說明關閉低能帶電粒子實驗的「目的」。
grammar.example: To preserve its limited electrical power, NASA recently turned off one experiment that studied low-energy charged particles.
grammar.focus: To preserve its limited electrical power

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「that」引導形容詞子句修飾前面的先行詞「the distance」，並在該子句中作為動詞「travel」的受詞。
grammar.example: A light-day represents the distance that light can travel over twenty-four hours, which equals more than sixteen billion miles.
grammar.focus: that light can travel over twenty-four hours

grammar.point: 現在分詞引導的分詞構句 (Participle Construction with Present Participle)
grammar.explain: 此處使用逗號連接現在分詞「recording」，表示與主要子句動作同時發生且為主動進行的伴隨狀態。
grammar.example: Today, two scientific instruments continue to function, recording magnetic fields and plasma waves.
grammar.focus: recording magnetic fields and plasma waves
